notes:
CONVENTIONS: GB are decimal. For diffusion and video models, q4_gb, q8_gb and fp16_gb give the size of the main transformer/UNet only, as GGUF Q4_K_M (Q4_K_S for FLUX.1) / Q8_0 / BF16. Where no GGUF exists (MiniMax H3), the vendor's INT8/BF16 and pruned-INT8 files are used. Text encoders are extra, and some are large: T5-XXL is ~4.9GB fp8, Qwen2.5-VL-7B ~8GB fp8, Mistral Small 24B for FLUX.2 dev ~24GB fp8, Gemma 4 12B for LTX-2.5, Qwen3-VL-32B for MiniMax H3 (14.6GB NVFP4).

min_runtime_mem_gb for image and video models is the practical NVIDIA VRAM at the common quant (GGUF Q4 or FP8), with ComfyUI offloading and the text encoder at fp8 or offloaded. That setup needs roughly 2x as much system RAM. For Wan 2.2 A14B, FLUX.2 dev, LTX-2.5, MiniMax H3 and HunyuanImage 3.0, plan on 64GB. On Apple Silicon, expect about 3-6x slower than an RTX 4090. In the browser, only SD1.5-class diffusion is realistic.

WHISPER: q4_gb is the whisper.cpp q5 file and fp16 is the ggml fp16 file. Where no GGUF exists, 4/8-bit sizes are estimates (about 0.6x and 1.07x params, with fp16 = 2x), marked medium confidence. context_k is 0 where it does not apply.

VLM sizes are Ollama tags and include the vision projector.

EXCLUSIONS: Wan 2.5/2.6/3.0 are API-only, so Wan 2.2 is the newest open Wan. Native-multimodal chat LLMs (Gemma 4, Qwen3.5, Llama 4, Mistral Small 3.x) belong in the chat catalog.

LICENCES:
- Tencent Hunyuan excludes the EU, UK and KR.
- MiniMax H3 excludes the US, EU, UK and KR, so the app may want to warn users in those regions.
- Research/non-commercial weights: Qwen-Image-2.1, FLUX.2 klein 9B, FLUX dev, Breeze TTS 2, F5-TTS, XTTS-v2 and MusicGen.

Speeds in notes are rough reference figures for ranking only.

Not verified in this pass but plausible: Fish Audio S2 Pro, IBM Granite Speech 4.1 2B and Canary-Qwen 2.5B could be added as further STT/TTS entries.
